license_required.quote: No person may engage in this state in any activity as a contractor or submit a bid to perform work as a contractor, as defined in this article, unless that person holds a license issued under the provisions of this article.

issuing_authority.quote: The West Virginia Contractor Licensing Board is continued.

name.quote: The West Virginia Contractor Licensing Board is continued.

type.quote: Eight of the appointed members shall be owners of businesses engaged in the various contracting industries, with at least one member appointed from each of the following contractor classes: One electrical contractor; one general building contractor; one general engineering contractor; one heating, ventilating and cooling contractor; one multifamily contractor; one piping contractor; one plumbing contractor; and one residential contractor

required.quote: A person desiring to be licensed as a contractor under this article shall submit to the board a written application requesting licensure

experience_source.quote: No license may be issued without examination pursuant to this subsection

exams.name: Contractor Licensing Examination
exams.notes: Board shall hold at least one examination in each calendar quarter for each specific classification of contractor, including plumbing contractor.
exams.quote: No license may be issued without examination pursuant to this subsection

interval_years.quote: A license issued under the provisions of this article expires one year from the date on which it is issued.

required.quote: If continuing education or other requirements are made a condition of license reinstatement after lapse, suspension, or revocation, these requirements must be satisfied before the license is reissued.

available.quote: the board may grant licenses of the same or equivalent classification to contractors licensed by other states, without written examination upon satisfactory proof furnished to the board that the qualifications of the applicants are equal to the qualifications of holders of similar licenses in this state

requirements.value: Applicant must hold equivalent license in another state, demonstrate qualifications equal to WV licensees, certify compliance as required, and pay the required fee.
requirements.quote: without written examination upon satisfactory proof furnished to the board that the qualifications of the applicants are equal to the qualifications of holders of similar licenses in this state, and upon certification to the board as required by 30-42-15(c) of this code, and upon payment of the required fee.

exists.quote: The West Virginia Contractor Licensing Board is continued. The board shall consist of 10 members appointed by the Governor

regulatory_model.quote: No person may engage in this state in any activity as a contractor or submit a bid to perform work as a contractor, as defined in this article, unless that person holds a license issued under the provisions of this article.

credential_type.quote: "License" means a license to engage in business in this state as a contractor in one of the classifications set out in this article.

is_mandatory.quote: No person may engage in this state in any activity as a contractor or submit a bid to perform work as a contractor, as defined in this article, unless that person holds a license issued under the provisions of this article.

title_protection.quote: Willfully or deliberately acting in the capacity of a contractor when not licensed or as a contractor by a person other than the person to whom the license is issued except as an employee of the licensee

scope_protection.quote: No person may engage in this state in any activity as a contractor or submit a bid to perform work as a contractor, as defined in this article, unless that person holds a license issued under the provisions of this article.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Abandonment without legal excuse of any construction project or operation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Abandonment, without legal excuse, of any construction project or operation engaged in or undertaken by the licensee

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful failure or refusal to complete a construction project causing material injury
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willful failure or refusal to complete a construction project or operation with reasonable diligence, thereby causing material injury to another

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful departure from or disregard of plans or specifications without consent
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willful departure from or disregard of plans or specifications in any material respect without the consent of the parties to the contract

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful or deliberate violation of building laws or regulations of the state or political subdivision
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willful or deliberate violation of the building laws or regulations of the state or of any political subdivision thereof

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful or deliberate failure to pay moneys due for materials or services rendered
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willful or deliberate failure to pay any moneys when due for any materials free from defect, or services rendered in connection with the persons operations as a contractor

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful or deliberate misrepresentation of a material fact in obtaining a license or in official licensing matters
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willful or deliberate misrepresentation of a material fact by an applicant or licensee in obtaining a license or in connection with official licensing matters

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful or deliberate failure to comply in any material respect with the provisions of the article or board rules
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willful or deliberate failure to comply in any material respect with the provisions of this article or the rules of the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully or deliberately acting in the capacity of a contractor when not licensed
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully or deliberately acting in the capacity of a contractor when not licensed or as a contractor by a person other than the person to whom the license is issued except as an employee of the licensee

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully or deliberately acting with intent to evade the provisions of the article through aiding unlicensed persons, combining with unlicensed persons, allowing license misuse, or disposing of license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully or deliberately acting with the intent to evade the provisions of this article by: (i) Aiding or abetting an unlicensed person to evade the provisions of this article; (ii) combining or conspiring with an unlicensed person to perform an unauthorized act; (iii) allowing a license to be used by an unlicensed person; or (iv) attempting to assign, transfer, or otherwise dispose of a license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in any willful, fraudulent, or deceitful act as a contractor causing substantial injury
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in any willful, fraudulent, or deceitful act in the capacity as a contractor whereby substantial injury is sustained by another

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing work not commensurate with general standard of the specific contractor classification or below applicable building code
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performing work which is not commensurate with a general standard of the specific classification of contractor or which is below a building or construction code adopted by the municipality or county in which the work is performed

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly employing persons who do not have the legal right to be employed in the United States
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly employing a person or persons who do not have the legal right to be employed in the United States

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to execute written contracts prior to performing contracting work
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to execute written contracts prior to performing contracting work in accordance with 30-42-10 of this code

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to abide by an order of the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to abide by an order of the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to satisfy a judgment or execution ordered by a magistrate court, circuit court, or arbitration board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to satisfy a judgment or execution ordered by a magistrate court, circuit court, or arbitration board.

bonding_required.quote: Order a contractor who has been found, after hearing, to have violated any provision of this article or the rules of the board to provide, as a condition of licensure, assurance of financial responsibility.

definition_quote.value: "Plumbing contractor" means a person whose principal business is the installation, maintenance, extension, and alteration of piping, plumbing fixtures, plumbing appliances and plumbing appurtenances, venting systems and public or private water supply systems within or adjacent to any building or structure; included in this definition is installation of gas piping, chilled water piping in connection with refrigeration processes and comfort cooling, hot water piping in connection with building heating and piping for stand pipes.
definition_quote.quote: "Plumbing contractor" means a person whose principal business is the installation, maintenance, extension, and alteration of piping, plumbing fixtures, plumbing appliances and plumbing appurtenances, venting systems and public or private water supply systems within or adjacent to any building or structure; included in this definition is installation of gas piping, chilled water piping in connection with refrigeration processes and comfort cooling, hot water piping in connection with building heating and piping for stand pipes.

small_project_dollar_threshold.quote: where the cost of the undertaking is $5,000 or more for residential work or $25,000 or more for commercial work.
